_nota: Cada preset es una plantilla de prompt. {idea} se reemplaza por lo que escribas. Editar este archivo NO requiere tocar codigo: anade, borra o cambia lo que quieras y recarga la app.

camaras.frase: static locked-off shot, tripod, no camera movement
slow dolly in, camera pushing forward steadily
slow dolly out, camera pulling back to reveal the scene
smooth 180 degree orbital arc around the subject
crane shot rising upward, revealing the environment below
low angle hero shot looking up at the subject, imposing
top-down birds eye view descending slowly
handheld documentary camera, subtle organic shake
sudden aggressive crash zoom in on the subject
tracking shot following the subject from behind, steadicam
bullet time, camera orbits while the action is frozen mid-motion
extreme zoom out from the subject to satellite view of earth
